identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, 'California School Age Consortium' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 93-0916869), and the organization's own site uses 'California School-Age Consortium (CalSAC)'
ProPublica lists the organization in El Sobrante, CA, and its website gives a PO Box in El Sobrante, CA 94820, matching the agenda location 'El Sobrante, CA'

Website describes training and support for out-of-school-time (after-school and summer) programs, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' and Expanded Learning Opportunities Program contracts
research.notes: Web search quota was exhausted, so the organization's site was found by fetching calsac.org directly and the ProPublica page by the EIN shown on the About page. ProPublica spells the name without a hyphen. No CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record was checked.

profile.summary: The California School-Age Consortium (CalSAC) is a nonprofit that supports people who work in after-school and summer programs across California. It offers training, leadership development programs and advocacy for out-of-school time programs and their workforce.

sources.title: California School Age Consortium - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Name, El Sobrante location and out-of-school-time services match OUSD's records; calsac.org confirms legal name, nonprofit status, EIN, phone, general email and PO Box, and ProPublica confirms EIN, 501(c)(3) and El Sobrante. Summary is neutral and supported; contact details are generic business ones.
